title: Router tests do not cover the HostAfterUnowned observe arms that name a self-started Claude turn's own identity
outcome: Router tests do not cover the HostAfterUnowned observe arms that name a self-started Claude turn's own identity
acceptance: A router test opens a self-started turn under its own command identity, takes a waiting prompt up with that prompt's started, then feeds output naming only the self-started identity, output naming that identity and the prompt, and a repeated started of the self-started identity, asserting each is Unchanged and that the result settles the prompt as HostAfterUnowned (mixed).
